title: Benzotriazolium picrate, P2_1/n polymorph (Zeng et al. 2011, COD 2230422) -- gas phase
notes: Second polymorph of BTPC (revision item C0): Zeng, Li & Wang, Acta Cryst. E67, o1464 (2011), doi:10.1107/S1600536811018307, COD 2230422, space group P2_1/n, a 14.4113, b 3.7608, c 24.941 A, beta 90.598 deg, Z 4, 298 K, R1 0.0616. The published paper models the P2_1/c form (CCDC 835950, case btpc). Here the asymmetric unit IS the hydrogen-bonded ion pair: N6-H6...O1 (phenolate), H...A 1.870 A, N...O 2.770 A, 160.0 deg, matching the deposited _geom_hbond loop (2.770(3) A, 160(3) deg). The cation carries H on N4 and N6 and none on N5, as in btpc (1H,3H-benzotriazolium); the deposited N-H distances are refined X-ray values (N4-H4 0.85, N6-H6 0.94 A). The cation's other N-H (N4-H4) donates a bifurcated bond to O1 and the ortho-nitro O2 of a 2_656 picrate (N...O 2.799 and 2.791 A); it is not represented here. Unconstrained, build_cluster.py would have picked that bifurcated image (two contacts outscore one), so the pair was built with --require-hbond N6:O1. No CCDC number is given in the COD CIF.
